basic_profile.bio: A 34-year-old software developer based in Austin, Texas. Passionate about Flutter development and enjoys contributing to open-source projects. When not coding, I indulge in reading LGBTQ+ literature and exploring the local food scene with my partner of 5 years. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. Love for natural body scents often leads to engaging discussions on niche subreddits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possesses a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and has over a decade of experience in mobile app development. Primarily self-taught in Flutter through online courses and community forums. Actively participates in tech meetups and workshops.
